0x1000D100.name: Endian_Swap16
0x1000D100.evidence: returns the low 16 bits of the argument with their two bytes exchanged
0x1000D100.summary: Swaps the bytes of a 16-bit value.

0x1000D120.name: Endian_Swap32
0x1000D120.evidence: returns the argument with its four bytes reversed ((x & 0xFF00 | x << 16) << 8 | (x & 0xFF0000 | x >> 16) >> 8)
0x1000D120.summary: Reverses the byte order of a 32-bit value.
